interaction_history.overview: An agoraphobic psychologist and a female detective must work together to take down a serial killer who copies serial killers from the past.
interaction_history.title: Copycat

interaction_history.overview: Summoned from an ashram in Tibet, Ace finds himself on a perilous journey into the jungles of Africa to find Shikaka, the missing sacred animal of the friendly Wachati tribe. He must accomplish this before the wedding of the Wachati's Princess to the prince of the warrior Wachootoos. If Ace fails, the result will be a vicious tribal war.
interaction_history.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls

interaction_history.overview: Hired by a powerful member of the Russian mafia to avenge an FBI sting that left his brother dead, the perfectionist Jackal proves an elusive target for the men charged with the task of bringing him down: a deputy FBI boss and a former IRA terrorist.
interaction_history.title: Jackal, The

interaction_history.overview: A female Senator succeeds in enrolling a woman into Combined Reconnaissance Team training where everyone expects her to fail.
interaction_history.title: G.I. Jane

interaction_history.overview: Countless wiseguy films are spoofed in this film that centers on the neuroses and angst of a powerful Mafia racketeer who suffers from panic attacks. When Paul Vitti needs help dealing with his role in the "family," unlucky shrink Dr. Ben Sobel is given just days to resolve Vitti's emotional crisis and turn him into a happy, well-adjusted gangster.
interaction_history.title: Analyze This

interaction_history.overview: As the English and French soldiers battle for control of the American colonies in the 18th century, the settlers and native Americans are forced to take sides. Cora and her sister Alice unwittingly walk into trouble but are reluctantly saved by Hawkeye, an orphaned settler adopted by the last of the Mohicans.
interaction_history.title: Last of the Mohicans, The

interaction_history.overview: A film about the life and career of the eccentric avant-garde comedian, Andy Kaufman.
interaction_history.title: Man on the Moon

interaction_history.overview: A young boy who tries to set his dad up on a date after the death of his mother. He calls into a radio station to talk about his dad’s loneliness which soon leads the dad into meeting a Journalist Annie who flies to Seattle to write a story about the boy and his dad. Yet Annie ends up with more than just a story in this popular romantic comedy.
interaction_history.title: Sleepless in Seattle

interaction_history.overview: A twice-divorced mother of three who sees an injustice, takes on the bad guy and wins -- with a little help from her push-up bra. Erin goes to work for an attorney and comes across medical records describing illnesses clustered in one nearby town. She starts investigating and soon exposes a monumental cover-up.
interaction_history.title: Erin Brockovich

interaction_history.overview: A sheltered Amish child is the sole witness of a brutal murder in a restroom at a Philadelphia train station, and he must be protected.  The assignment falls to a taciturn detective who goes undercover in a Pennsylvania Dutch community. On the farm, he slowly assimilates despite his urban grit and forges a romantic bond with the child's beautiful mother.
interaction_history.title: Witness

unique_tastes.summary: Unique tastes: Strong preference for Drama and Romance (Many highly rated films fall within these genres, indicating a strong emotional connection to character-driven narratives.); Appreciation for Action films with dramatic elements (Several action films rated positively suggest enjoyment of intense, plot-driven experiences that also explore deeper themes.); Interest in Thrillers with psychological depth (High ratings for thrillers indicate a preference for suspenseful narratives that engage the mind and evoke strong emotions.); Enjoyment of Comedic elements in Drama and Romance (Positive ratings for comedies that blend with drama and romance suggest a liking for humor that complements emotional storytelling.); Favoring War-themed narratives (Films that incorporate war themes and are rated positively show an appreciation for stories that explore conflict and human resilience.). Liked patterns: Preference for films that combine Drama and Romance, Enjoyment of films with strong emotional narratives, Tendency to rate thrillers highly when they include psychological elements. Disliked patterns: Dislike for action films that lack depth or strong narratives, Negative response to comedies that do not resonate emotionally.
